page.layout: Two printed pages on the scan. Left page: a notes column at the far left, one main text column in the centre (the book's running text, with the marginal notes u, x, y beside it), and a catchword below. Right page: only its left edge is visible, cut off at the scan border, with a running head fragment and some partial lines of text.

main_text.p: dubitarent aliqui ; alij ejus personam conuitiis onerare,quenquam tamen vel Donatistarum, vel Arrianorum, vel Mi-letianorum vitæ ejus insidias clàm tetendisse, aut vim intulisse palàm non legimus : cùm tamen tanta esset Arrianorum multitudo, ut aliquot Arimi-nense, Seleuciense, Syrmiense. Vide etiam Angust.con-tra Parmen. Cap.6.{u}Concilia ex plarísque Orientis ciuitatibus congregata, ab eorum partibus stare videretur, eisque adhæreret Eusebius Nicomediensis Episcopus, Constantiæ Imperatoris sorori valdè charus : Faueret item Eusebius Pamphili Cæsariensis, quem Imperator non modò in oculis, sed secum in sinu quasi & pectore semper gerebat. Ingemiscebat (inquit Aduersus Luciferia-nos.{x}Hieronymus) Christianus Orbis, & miratus est se subito factum esse Arrianum : ] non verò ingemiscebat Arrianum factum fuisse Regicidam,erat siquidem Niceph. lib.8.ca.51.{y}æqui-uocator, & æquiuocantium author Ar-rius ; Regicida tamen, vel regicidarum patronus non erat. page.notes: The right-hand page is cut off at the scan border; only the first 1–4 letters of its lines are visible, so those lines are fragments marked [?]. The "cipem" at the foot is the catchword. The stray "]" after "Arrianum:" is printed as shown. The reference mark "y" in the margin is printed as a Greek-looking symbol. No other damage noted.
